integrity: Exact exhaustive 4096-orientation enumeration, independent BFS/Floyd–Warshall cross-check, analytic four-step proof and inclusion–exclusion denominator; finite certificate is not evidence for larger games.
scientific_limitations: Strict generic two-action games with exactly three labeled players; existentially chosen strict best-response transitions, not convergence under exogenous activation; 1993 directed-hypercube full text not inspected; no claim of new qualitative weak acyclicity.
title: Sharp four-step equilibrium access and exact connectivity spectrum in binary three-player games
